sentences.zh: 而遗产管理委员会发现自己陷入了一种反常的境地，他们辩称不，他的姓名、肖像和未来盈利潜力几乎为零，

sentences.en: So they're making a very extreme argument.

sentences.zh: 这是两个男人詹姆斯·萨费楚克和韦德·罗布森的故事，他们都声称杰克逊在他们小时候对他们进行过性虐待。

sentences.en: It was also sexual seduction.

sentences.en: And I know people all over the world are going to be in an uproar and debating whether or not Michael Jackson did these things or not, whether these two men are lying or not lying.
sentences.zh: 我知道全世界的人都会一片哗然，并争论迈克尔·杰克逊究竟有没有做过这些事，这两个男人是在说谎还是没有说谎。

sentences.zh: 首先，他们对这部电影本身《离开梦幻岛》展开了猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: when they aired a concert film live from BuchareSt.

sentences.zh: 而在合同中，有一些相当标准的条款，即不诋毁条款。

sentences.zh: 遗产管理委员会的律师辩称，30 年后播出《离开梦幻岛》违反了该不诋毁条款，这是一个相当不寻常的论点。

sentences.en: But eventually, neither side will talk about what happened except to say that it was amicably settled.

sentences.en: But they did reach a settlement, and you can't find Leaving Neverland on HBO's platforms anymore.

sentences.en: Wow.

sentences.zh: 是的，在美国已经无法通过

sentences.en: Okay, well, what's the second prong of the strategy?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那这项策略的第二招是什么？

sentences.en: They also thought about making their own documentary.
sentences.zh: 他们还考虑过制作自己的纪录片。

sentences.zh: 但相反，他们决定拍一部传记片，这可以成为终极的品牌重塑。

sentences.en: So they start putting together this A-list team of talent.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始组建这支全明星阵容的才华团队。

sentences.zh: 他几年前制作了皇后乐队传记片《波希米亚狂想曲》，那是一部空前巨作，全球票房接近十亿美元。

sentences.en: And music biopics, if they work properly, they bind the music to a feel-good story, a triumphant story,

sentences.en: where the audience can enjoy these songs they love at sort of maximum volume with fantastic visuals.

sentences.en: But they can also feel connected to the artist as a person, as a sort of character in a movie.

sentences.en: The wild thing about this strategy, I got hold of a copy of the original script for the biopic.
sentences.zh: 关于这个策略，最疯狂的事情是，我弄到了一份传记片原始剧本的副本。

sentences.en: And it wasn't just Jackson denying the accusations.
sentences.zh: 里面不仅有杰克逊对指控的否认。
